title: Map Markdown selected-folder consent to connector configuration

findings.summary: CLI and local-app enrollment persist only absolute config.path. MarkdownFolderConfig.page_size and exclude are constructor-only and would be dropped or refused by host-state encode/decode.

Markdown loadConnector checks sourceCaptureAdmission only. It does not pre-join app catalog required_fields (text, subjects, metadata) to grant.allowed_fields. Field mismatch is detected later at authorizeSourceCapture. Existing test covers capture refusal when text is omitted.
CLI connect constructs the connector and health-checks before persist. App markdown enroll resolves path and persists without constructing the connector.
